messages:
maya: Heads-up — CI went red on my branch after I bumped some pre-commit hooks. The failing step is the pyright hook. CI link: https://ci.internal/builds/54821
ci-bot: build failed at step 'typecheck (pyright)' for job 54821. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/54821
maya: error excerpt from logs:
```
src/api/user_service.py:88: error: Argument of type 'None' cannot be assigned to parameter 'username' of type 'str'
  --> src/api/user_service.py:88
```
maya: I didn't touch that file in this PR, only .pre-commit-config.yaml to bump tool refs
tom: can you paste the exact change to .pre-commit-config.yaml?
maya: snippet:
```diff
-  - repo: https://github.com/microsoft/pyright
-    rev: v1.0.3
+  - repo: https://github.com/microsoft/pyright
+    rev: v1.1.2
```
tom: ah, pyright 1.1.x introduced a stricter check on None->str assignments in some call sites. That would explain it
arya: we pushed a devex pre-commit sweep yesterday, might be the rollout. cc @devex
liam: quick plan: 1) confirm by skipping pre-commit in CI 2) try pinned-to-old-rev 3) decide pin vs adjust config in repo (pyrightconfig.json)
maya: kicked off rerun with SKIP_PRECOMMIT=1 to validate now
ci-bot: rerun queued: build 54821-skipprecommit (triggered by maya)
ci-bot: 54821-skipprecommit succeeded ✅
maya: so the underlying codebase is fine — it's the pyright hook change
rik: can you reproduce locally? run `pre-commit run pyright --all-files` in a fresh venv and paste output
maya: reproduced locally using pre-commit with pyright v1.1.2. Using a tox env pinned to v1.0.3 passes.
tom: options: a) pin the pre-commit rev back to v1.0.3 in this repo b) add a temporary pyrightconfig.json to silence the new check c) update code sites to satisfy the stricter typing (not ideal for a quick unblock)
arya: I'd prefer pinning per-repo until we do a coordinated infra bump across repos. Avoids config divergence and churn.
devex: devex here — we had intended to stage the pyright bump but the sweep went a bit faster than planned. Recommend pin in this repo + add an infra ticket to run a canary sweep across critical repos with pyright 1.1.2 next week.
liam: agree. Maya, can you open a quick revert PR that restores the previous rev and mention the infra follow-up?
maya: PR opened: https://git.internal/p/954 — it reverts pyright rev to v1.0.3 and adds a short note in the description linking issue #602 (toolchain bump fallout)
tom: once the PR CI finishes please +1 so we can unblock the merge train. This is blocking ~6 small PRs in the queue.
ci-bot: started build for PR 954
maya: one more thing — I noticed rustfmt changed formatting in another repo after the same image bump. Sounds like the shared CI image updated multiple tools. Filing an infra ticket and linking it in the PR description.
liam: good catch. Add the rustfmt note and the list of suspected impacted repos to the infra ticket so the release team can triage.
maya: added note and linked issue #602 to the PR description. PR build is running.
ci-bot: PR 954 passed checks — merge queued
maya: thanks everyone. We'll keep the pin until devex rolls a controlled upgrade and does the canary sweep. :thumbsup:
